review_candidates.description: Description Are you interested in unleashing your passion for IT and play a pivotal role in securing our organization's technological infrastructure to Government standards? We are looking for a skilled Intermediate Systems Administrator who will ensure the reliability, security, and performance of our IT environments—including stand-alone systems, networked infrastructures, and secure cloud solutions in specialized Special Access and SCI facilities. Ranked among Computerworld 's Top Places to Work in IT for 8 consecutive years, APL opens the door for you to make a difference! On this remarkable team, contribute to the service delivery and security of our Highly Classified information systems. In doing so, you'll address the unique needs of our Research Programs. As a Intermediate Systems Administrator, the following tasks await you: Provide intermediate system administration service, maintenance, and support for Linux, Windows, virtualization, storage devices and systems in highly classified environments. Maintain, and document systems using approved architectures and baselines. Troubleshoot intermediate issues in Linux operating systems and Windows Operating Systems. Support virtualized environments, including virtual machine monitoring, troubleshooting, and routine maintenance using commercial off the shelf software. Perform system backups, recovery activities, and scheduled continuity testing to protect data availability and integrity. Troubleshoot and administrator storage devices, including capacity monitoring, backups, and routine troubleshooting. Perform basic network switch troubleshooting, including ports, VLANs, connectivity, and segmentation, in coordination with senior systems administrators. Create and manage user and privileged accounts, access permissions, passwords, and periodic access reviews. Apply patches, remediate findings, and maintain approved configuration baselines of IT technology. Monitor system health, capacity, availability, and security status; respond to alerts and document corrective actions. Support RMF and authorization activities by maintaining configuration records, procedures, diagrams, control evidence, and other assigned security documentation. Apply cybersecurity, OPSEC, COMSEC, and classified-environment requirements during daily system administration. Maintain technical documentation, SOPs, system records, and ticket updates in the approved IT service management system. Assist with system upgrades, migrations, technology refreshes, testing, and operational transitions under senior technical direction. Maintain current knowledge of applicable technologies, vulnerabilities, security requirements, and system administration practices. Qualifications You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you... Have an Associate’s or Technical degree with 5+ years of relevant experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Demonstrated success in roles that require both responsive technical support and proactive system administration. Proficiency in Windows and/or Linux system administration, including user management through Active Directory (or equivalent) and Group Policy configuration. Hands-on experience with cloud/virtualization technologies (e.g., AWS, Azure, VMware, Hyper-V, QUEMU), and network troubleshooting. Familiarity with security practices, including deploying patches, configuring firewalls, and applying Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) standards as per JSIG or NISPOM guidance. Experience with certificate management (PKI, RSA, Windows/Linux certificate services) and security tools (e.g., ACAS, SCAP, Splunk, Ivanti, McAfee). Current DoD 8140 Systems Administration certification (e.g., Security+, SSCP, CISSP-ISSE, etc.). Cloud certifications or equivalent platform-specific credentials are highly desired. Have a Top-Secret level security clearance by your start date and can ultimately obtain TS/SCI level clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship. You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you... Have a Bachelors Degree and 8+ years of professional experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Certified for multiple technologies, cloud, or virtualization software. NetApp or SAN experience. Experience manually building physical systems. Configured managed switches. Experience with endpoint protection applications (e.g. Splunk). Practical experience with programming / scripting languages. Working familiarity with Director of Central Intelligence Directives (DCID) or Intelligence Community Directives (ICD) security requirements. Experience with HP Secure Print. We are seeking an experienced Lead Network Engineer to design, deploy, and manage enterprise-grade network infrastructure across our retail store portfolio and distribution center operations. This role is the subject matter expert for Aruba wireless solutions, providing hands-on leadership for WiFi, LAN/WAN designs and deployments. The ideal candidate thrives in fast-paced retail and logistics environments, balances project work with escalation support, and brings a proactive mindset to network reliability and security. Key Responsibilities Wireless Network Design & Deployment (Aruba) Lead end-to-end Aruba WiFi deployments for new and existing retail stores and distribution centers, from design through post-deployment validation. Conduct professional RF site surveys using Ekahau Pro and similar predictive/post-installation tools; produce detailed heat maps, coverage reports, and capacity recommendations. Design and maintain Aruba wireless infrastructure including APs (indoor/outdoor), Mobility Conductors/Gateways, and AOS-8/AOS-10 architecture. Optimize RF environments for high-density retail and warehouse settings, including 2.4GHz/5GHz/6GHz band management, channel planning, and interference mitigation. Develop and enforce wireless security standards (WPA3-Enterprise, 802.1X, PPSK) aligned with PCI-DSS requirements for retail payment environments. Administer Aruba ClearPass for network access control, guest management, and device onboarding as it relates to wireless policy enforcement. LAN Architecture & Operations Design, deploy, and maintain switching infrastructure (Aruba CX, HP ProCurve) across retail stores and distribution centers. Manage VLAN segmentation strategies for POS systems, corporate devices, IoT/OT equipment, and guest networks. Configure and troubleshoot spanning tree (MSTP/RSTP), link aggregation (LACP), and Layer 3 routing protocols (OSPF, BGP). Perform capacity planning and lifecycle management for access-layer and distribution-layer switching infrastructure. WAN & Fortinet SD-WAN Architect, deploy, and manage Fortinet SD-WAN solutions across retail branch locations, replacing or augmenting traditional MPLS circuits with broadband/LTE/5G overlays. Configure FortiGate firewall policies, IPSec VPN tunnels, and SD-WAN application steering rules aligned to business-critical retail applications (POS, inventory, ERP). Monitor WAN performance and SLA adherence using Fortinet analytics and third-party NMS tools; proactively identify and resolve connectivity degradation. Collaborate with ISPs and telecom vendors to manage circuit provisioning, failover configurations, and SLA enforcement. Maintain FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer for centralized policy management and log analytics across distributed locations. Operations, Support & Projects Serve as Level 3 escalation for network incidents, providing root-cause analysis and permanent corrective actions. Lead network workstreams for new store openings, store refreshes, and DC expansions — coordinating with construction, real estate, and IT project managers. Maintain comprehensive network documentation including topology diagrams, IP address management (IPAM), configuration standards, and runbooks. Define and enforce network standards, change management procedures, and configuration baselines across the enterprise. Mentor junior and mid-level network engineers and provide knowledge transfer on Aruba and Fortinet technologies. Required Qualification Education & Experience 7 – 10 years of progressive hands-on experience in enterprise network engineering. Minimum 3 years of experience in retail, hospitality, distribution center, or warehouse network environments with multi-site responsibility (50+ locations strongly preferred). Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Technical Skills — Required Aruba Wireless: Deep expertise in Aruba AP deployment, Mobility Controller/Conductor, AOS-8 and AOS-10, RF design, and troubleshooting. WiFi Site Survey Tools: Proficiency with Ekahau Pro (predictive design, post-installation validation) Aruba ClearPass: Working knowledge of CPPM for NAC, guest portals, and device profiling in support of wireless deployments. Fortinet SD-WAN: Demonstrated experience with FortiGate SD-WAN, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, and FortiOS policy management. Switching / LAN: Aruba CX, VLANs, 802.1Q trunking, LACP, STP/MSTP, Layer 3 inter-VLAN routing. WAN Protocols: BGP, OSPF, IPSec VPN, WAN circuit management. Security: Firewall policy management, 802.1X/NAC, PCI-DSS network segmentation requirements. Network Monitoring: Proficiency with SNMP-based NMS tools (SolarWinds, PRTG, or equivalent), packet capture analysis (Wireshark). Preferred Qualifications Aruba Certified Mobility Professional (ACMP) or Aruba Certified ClearPass Associate/Professional (ACCA/ACCP). CCNP (Enterprise or Security) or equivalent vendor-neutral certification. Experience with Aruba Central (cloud-managed networking) and Aruba AIOps. Familiarity with retail-specific systems: POS network requirements, IoT/OT device segmentation (HVAC, digital signage, self-checkout), and loss prevention systems. Experience with SD-WAN migration projects from legacy MPLS to hybrid WAN architectures. Familiarity with ITSM platforms (ServiceNow) and IPAM solutions (Infoblox, SolarWinds IPAM). Knowledge of cloud networking concepts (AWS/Azure VPN Gateways, Direct Connect/ExpressRoute). Experience with automation and scripting (Python, Ansible) for network configuration management. Core Competencies Technical Problem Solving Strong analytical skills for diagnosing complex, multi-layer network issues in production retail environments. Project Management Ability to manage multiple concurrent network projects (store openings, refreshes, DC expansions) from scoping through delivery. Communication Translates complex technical topics for non-technical stakeholders including retail operations and store leadership. Documentation Discipline Maintains accurate, up-to-date network documentation, diagrams, and change records without prompting. Collaboration Works effectively across IT, security, vendor, and field operations teams; builds credibility through expertise and reliability. Continuous Improvement Proactively identifies network performance gaps and proposes solutions before issues escalate. Work Environment & Physical Requirements Hybrid work model — 3 days per week mandatory in-office at Marlborough, MA headquarters; remaining days remote. Up to 25% travel to retail stores and distribution centers for site surveys, new store openings, network installations, and infrastructure audits. Ability to work in active retail and warehouse environments, including walking distribution center floors and working in network closets/data rooms. Must be able to lift and carry network equipment (APs, switches, routers) up to 50 lbs and work on ladders when required for AP mounting. Occasional after-hours and weekend work required for maintenance windows, store openings, and critical incident response. On-call rotation participation for after-hours network support escalation. This is a hybrid role. Tuesday through Thursday are in-office days at BJ's Club Support Center in Marlborough, MA and Monday and Friday are remote days.
